- Criticizing others’ morals can reflect one’s own values more than objective truth.

True respectability may not lie in perfection or conformity, but in courage, empathy, and integrity—qualities that persist even in difficult times. And if we look closely, they are still there, quietly shaping the world, even if we don’t always see them.
